name: Website and social archive for solo/small RIAs
buyer: Solo and small SEC-registered investment advisers who must retain website and social marketing content
pain: Per-seat archiving suites are priced and contracted for larger firms, while SEC Rule 204-2 requires 5-year retention and quick retrieval.
wedge: Archive public website pages and social posts only, with no email or text, at about $29/mo flat per firm with free export and no annual lock-in. The edge is price and narrow scope, and it is unproven.

scan1Edge.entrant_basis: Flat $29/mo for a scoped product covering websites and social only. The notes estimate snapshot compute and storage under $5/month per client, which is unverified.
scan1Edge.falsifier: If RIAs need email and text archiving in the same tool, or require a compliance-audited 'compliant' claim the entrant cannot make, a website-only product at $29 will not be bought.
